description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across grouped transformer layer ranges for four methods/settings, with a dashed baseline reference. The x-axis is labeled by categorical layer groups “Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32,” evenly spaced with no numeric units. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” on a linear scale in percent, spanning from about −25% up to 5%, with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, and −15%, and a gray dashed horizontal baseline at 0% labeled “Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit.” The yellow line with circular markers (solid) labeled “LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit” stays near 0%: approximately 0% at Layer1-4 and Layer5-12, dips to about −2% at Layer13-20, returns to about 0% at Layer21-28, and ends slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (solid) labeled “LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit” starts at about 0% at Layer1-4, is around −1% at Layer5-12, reaches about −5% at Layer13-20, rises to about −2% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0% at Layer29-32. The light-blue line with circular markers (solid) labeled “RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit” begins around −2% at Layer1-4, is around −2% to −3% at Layer5-12, drops to roughly −13% at Layer13-20, rises to about −2% at Layer21-28, and ends around −1% at Layer29-32. The dark-blue line with square markers (solid) labeled “RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit” starts near −3% at Layer1-4, is around −4% at Layer5-12, drops to about −25% at Layer13-20, rises to about −6% at Layer21-28, and ends near −3% at Layer29-32.
